records.notes: Items are picked up at AWLA's Animal Services desk. Pantry relies on donations; specific brands and varieties are not guaranteed. Supports approximately 450 families each month (per page). Non-residents are referred to pantries in Alexandria City, Fairfax County and Washington D.C.

services.description: Community Care (OneHealth) clinics: free or low-cost wellness exam, rabies vaccine, standard vaccines (DA2PP, FVRCP), deworming, flea/tick preventatives, behavior consultation, grooming, plus human support services and referrals.

records.notes: Voucher prices: dog spay $200, cat spay $145, dog neuter $185, cat neuter $80. Vouchers valid 90 days, non-transferable, no refunds; surgery at partner clinics (Anicira Veterinary Center - Manassas, Arlington Animal Hospital, Caring Hands Animal Hospital - Alexandria and - Arlington, Columbia Pike Animal Hospital, Shirlington Animal Hospital). Pets must be current on rabies and distemper vaccines or purchase them ($10-25 each) at the appointment. Vouchers can also be purchased in person at the shelter.

services.description: Low-cost spay/neuter vouchers (anesthesia, surgery and post-op pain medication) for income-eligible pet owners; surgery at participating partner veterinary clinics.

eligibility.details: Annual household income of $60,000 or less; further income-based discounts available.
Some vouchers are available only to Arlington County residents.
Must purchase and receive a voucher before calling the participating vet to schedule.

records.location_name: Animal Welfare League of Arlington shelter
records.raw_eligibility_text: Pet owners with an annual household income of $60,000 or less are eligible. There are further income-based discounts available, please email communitysupport@awla.org for more information. ... Some vouchers are available only to Arlington County residents.

records.notes: Covers emergencies case-by-case and listed chronic conditions (e.g., allergies, arthritis, diabetes, kidney disease, seizures). Not covered: routine/wellness care, vaccines, dental, orthopedic surgeries, cancer, euthanasia, among others.

services.description: Veterinary Assistance Program: financial help for emergency or chronic veterinary conditions for low-income Arlington County pet owners. Call the shelter for more information.

eligibility.details: Must be residents of Arlington County, VA.

records.location_name: Animal Welfare League of Arlington shelter
records.raw_eligibility_text: The League's Veterinary Assistance Program helps low-income Arlington County pet owners who need veterinary care for their pets' emergency or chronic conditions but cannot afford the costs. ... Pet owners must be residents of Arlington County, VA to qualify for this program.

records.notes: Common situations: emergency home evacuation (fire, flood, natural disaster), unexpected hospitalization, domestic abuse admission into a shelter. Owners encouraged first to explore friends, family or local boarding. Some pets may be placed in a temporary foster home. Call the Pet Resource Center.

records.notes: Nonprofit veterinary hospital 'open to all' offering medical, surgical and dental care with published prices. Page states it is unable to accept new patients at this time for sick and wellness care (established clients only). Accepts cash, Visa, Mastercard (no checks); payment plans offered. Financial assistance details also at https://anicira.org/manassas-financial-assistance/. Listed as a partner clinic for AWLA and Fairfax County spay/neuter vouchers. Conflicting criteria: the Prince William SPCA (https://pwspca.org/resources-2/) describes Sashi's Fund eligibility as income at or below 150% of the Federal Poverty Level or SNAP/Medicaid participation, with proof of residency and income/assistance; the PW SPCA page also says Anicira is no longer accepting new clients for medical or wellness appointments, only surgical and dentistry cases.

services.description: Nonprofit low-cost veterinary hospital: spay/neuter, vaccinations, general surgery, dentistry; Sashi's Fund financial assistance for Medicaid-eligible Manassas/Manassas Park/Prince William families; $40 Pit Fix spay/neuter for pit bull-type dogs.

eligibility.details: Sashi's Fund and Pit Fix: residents of Manassas, Manassas Park, and Prince William County.
Sashi's Fund: must qualify for Medicaid; proof of eligibility is required.

records.raw_eligibility_text: Sashi's Fund provides assistance to pet families in Manassas, Manassas Park, and Prince William County who qualify for Medicaid in accessing veterinary care. Proof of eligibility is required. ... Pit Bull Terriers and Pit Bull mixes residing in Manassas, Manassas Park, and Prince William County are eligible to receive a $40 spay/neuter surgery through the Pit Fix program.
